hero.title: Run your dental clinic in one modern system
hero.description: {brand} brings your patient database, appointment schedule, doctors, dental chart, treatment courses, payments, and SMS reminders together in one platform.

features.title: The clinic's core workflows in one CRM
features.subtitle: Administrators, doctors, and clinic managers all work in one system.

items.title: Patient database
items.desc: Patient details, phone number, medical history, documents, and X-rays in a single card.

items.title: Appointment schedule
items.desc: Manage appointments by day, week, and doctor. Reduce scheduling conflicts.

items.title: Doctors
items.desc: Separate roles and access rights for doctors, reception, assistants, and admins.

items.title: Dental chart
items.desc: Track diagnosis, condition, fillings, implants, root canals, and notes per tooth.

items.title: Treatment courses
items.desc: Run treatment plans step by step and track visits and completed work.

items.title: Payments and debt
items.desc: Track patient payments, service prices, and outstanding balances accurately.

items.title: Reports
items.desc: Monitor statistics on appointments, revenue, staff performance, and patient flow.

items.title: Multi-tenant system
items.desc: Each clinic or branch runs on its own subdomain with an isolated data environment.

howItWorks.title: Connecting your clinic to the CRM is easy
howItWorks.subtitle: Launching the system, adding staff, and booking your first patient is simple.

steps.title: Register your clinic
steps.desc: Set up your subdomain, clinic profile, and core settings in a few minutes.

steps.title: Add your team
steps.desc: Grant doctors, reception, assistants, and admins role-based access.

steps.title: Book patients for appointments
steps.desc: Find patients by phone number, create new patients, and set appointment times.

steps.title: Track treatment and reports
steps.desc: Manage the dental chart, treatment courses, payments, and clinic metrics in real time.

about.title: Move your clinic to an organized, fast, and controllable system
